title: Material 3 Expressive: responsive shape
summary: Teach a responsive spatial control while keeping effect changes and calibrated measurements truthful.
use_when: A tactile consumer control or a deliberate focal interaction benefits from a bounded geometric response.
avoid_when: Deformation would alter a measured value, or repeated spring movement would distract from precision work.
